module: Auxiliary lightbar (beacon lights) controller with configurable modes (type "auxiliary"). Each mode defines, per electrics value name, a sequence of states (duration, value) repeated in a loop as long as the main electrics value (by default "lightbar") is > 0; a single-state sequence becomes a static value. The electrics values produced are multiplied by the intensity of the main value (0..1). A "Lightbar Modes" radial menu allows changing the mode.
notes: jbeam keys (default): lightbarElectricsName ("lightbar"), modes (header table with name and config; config is a header table electric/duration/value), defaultModeIndex (1), resetTriggerElectricNames (list of electrics names whose change resets the sequences to zero; lightbarElectricsName is added to it).
Durations are in seconds. The mode change displays an interface message.
Inconsistency: init adds lightbarElectricsName into the jbeamData.resetTriggerElectricNames table itself (modifying the jbeam table, which accumulates at each init if the table is reused).
reset(jbeamData) reapplies defaultModeIndex; setState/applyRemoteModeIndex changes mode without a message or cutting the output values.

init.desc: Builds the modes (animated sequences and static values), registers the radial menu entry if several modes exist.

updateGFX.desc: Advances the sequences of each electrics value according to dt and writes electrics.values.

toggleMode.desc: Switches to the next mode (returns to the first after the last).

setModeIndex.desc: Activates the mode at the given index: resets the sequences to zero, applies the static values and displays a message. Does nothing if the index does not exist.

setState.desc: Applies the mode index from a state table if valid.
